summary: Give each KC2 X3 V2 half a protected 301230-class 3.7 V 100 mAh battery beneath its socketed nice!nano, direct-solder the insulated battery leads to the carrier, switch BAT+ with an IMMS-12V, return reset to the controller-key gap, mirror POWER/RESET outside-in, remove the obsolete lower-housing battery cavity, and preserve antenna/RF gates.
resolved_assumptions: Direct soldering applies only to insulated leads already attached to the protected cell; soldering bare pouch tabs is forbidden.
The exact purchasable 301230 MPN, maximum swollen thickness and lead exit remain a physical procurement gate before ordering, not a blocker to digital implementation.
All absolute left/right placement statements use the PCB top/component-side view.
Each half is electrically independent and receives one battery, one power switch and one reset switch.
The existing lead slot may remain only as an unnetted strain-relief feature; the lower housing shall not contain a battery-body cavity.
No A2501 board connector or A2501-02Y housing is installed in this design.
implied_requirements: BAT+ passes through the local power switch; B- remains unswitched.
IMMS common pad 1 and selected throw pad 2 are used; pad 3 remains no-connect.
Outside-to-inside order is POWER, RESET, antenna on both halves.
The battery, switch metal, pads, traces and leads remain outside the antenna keepout volume.
The socketed controller remains removable with the battery installed.
First-article BLE and power-transition tests remain mandatory.

semantic_equivalences.normalized: between the carrier PCB top and the socketed nice!nano underside, not below the carrier in the lower housing
left half top view PWR|RST; right half top view RST|PWR
